artworks.title: Saint Stephen before the Council
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple full-body figures within an architectural setting. On the left, an elderly man is seated on an elevated platform, possibly a throne, dressed in elaborate robes and a bishop's miter. In front of him, figures stand, including another bearded man who seems to be speaking. Other men in robes, some with wreaths on their heads, and armored soldiers with plumed helmets and spears stand nearby on the right. Pillars surround the scene, and through an archway in the background, a tower and distant landscape are visible. In a smaller panel to the right, a hillside scene with people and a city in the background is illustrated, with a dog lying on the steps in the foreground. The illustration is detailed and depicts a narrative within an architectural framework.

artworks.title: Devout Men Carrying Saint Stephen to His Burial
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene under a classical architectural setting. The image features a group of figures gathered in the foreground around a central event. The scene includes a grand colonnaded structure with detailed textures and expressive figures engaging in various actions. In the background, there are more figures and buildings with domes and spires, suggesting an urban environment. The drawing is rendered in a monochrome palette, emphasizing line work and contrast.

artworks.title: The People of Samaria Receive the Word of God
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a biblical scene. Multiple figures are surrounding two central figures. In the foreground, the central figures with halos are engaged in a religious ritual with a group of kneeling and seated characters. The background shows an architectural setting with columns, steps, and figures in various poses. Rays of light shine down above the central figures. The drawing is detailed, focusing on the expressions and gestures of each figure, conveying a moment of reverence and spiritual significance.

artworks.title: The Angel Orders Saint Philip to Accompany the Ethiopian Eunuch
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel visiting a figure indoors. The angel, with wings and robes, reaches out towards a haloed figure. The room contains a table with books and a candlestick, along with a large book on the ground. Through a window, an outdoor scene is visible showing a road with a chariot, a castle, and a tree. The drawing is detailed and resembles engravings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: The Baptism of the Eunuch by Saint Philip
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene beside a river. The image depicts a riverbank where a figure is kneeling, and another is standing near them. A two-horse-drawn chariot carrying two figures is shown beside them. The background features a bridge crossing the river and a settlement with buildings and a tower or castle structure, set against a mountainous landscape. In the sky, angelic figures are illustrated above the scene. The drawing is intricately composed, capturing various actions within a narrative context.

artworks.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with soldiers and horses in a chaotic setting. The central figure is a soldier or warrior with a spear, surrounded by other figures in different actions. The scene includes armored individuals, charging horses, and a backdrop of a fortified city or settlement. The detailed line work suggests a classical or historical setting, with themes of war and conquest. Architectural elements like fortified walls and rocky landscapes add depth to the scene, highlighting the tumultuous events.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Escapes from Damascus
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image shows a figure running and looking upwards to the right. The person has curly hair and a curly beard, dressed in flowing garments and appears to be barefoot. They hold a staff in one hand and something under their other arm. In the background, two figures lean over a large stone structure, lowering another person in a basket. The scene is set in a city with arches and buildings visible under a starry night sky with a crescent moon.

artworks.title: The Healing of Eneas by Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: The image depicts three main figures in the foreground. To the right, a bearded man with curly hair is partially dressed, sitting up from a reclined position. He is twisting his torso, resting one hand on the cloth-covered bed and the other on his head, looking towards the other two figures. The central figure is a man with a short beard and curly hair, wearing a long robe and gesturing with his hands as he stands facing the seated man. To their left, a woman with her hair covered appears to be in motion, holding the edges of her robe, her facial features obscured by shadows. A small dog is lying on the ground beside the bed. The interior setting includes a large fireplace or hearth in the center, with various pots and pans hanging on the walls. To the left, a person is shown drawing water from a well beneath a balcony. The background shows architectural elements such as buildings and archways, with additional figures visible through doorways and the open courtyard area. Various household items and tools hang along the walls.

artworks.title: The Raising of Tabitha
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Maerten van Heemskerck
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a narrative scene with three primary segments. The left section shows an architectural backdrop with columns, an archway, a figure walking outside, and two robed figures conversing on a staircase indoors. The middle segment shows multiple robed individuals around a reclining figure with a sense of urgency and religious symbolism. The right segment depicts three figures in an interior scene that looks like a baptismal or ceremonial practice. The drawing is detailed with careful linework and composition.

artworks.title: The Angel Commands Cornelius to Fetch Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Biblical scene with a soldier, a philosopher, and a celestial being. The central figure, dressed in Roman attire, is under angelic visitation in a classical architectural setting. In the foreground, a heavily armored Roman centurion converses with another figure, both against a backdrop of steps leading to a bustling urban scene. To the right, a venerable bearded man sits on an ornate chair, seemingly engaged in an interaction with an ethereal angelic figure. Above and to the right, another angelic figure emerges from the clouds. The illustration is detailed with delineated architectural elements, reflective of Renaissance-style interpretation of Roman architecture and everyday life.

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple scenes interconnected in a narrative format. The main composition is divided into various sections, each depicting different actions. In the left panel, there are figures engaged in activities within an architectural setting. Another part shows people in prayer-like postures surrounded by arches and curtains. A figure at a window observes the outside. On the right side, a figure stands by a ledge looking at a distant city, while mythical creatures float among the clouds above. The composition includes classical architectural elements and implies a narrative with spiritual or divine themes.

artworks.title: Cornelius Worshipping Saint Peter
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene in a grand architectural setting. The drawing depicts a group of figures interacting inside a classical architectural environment, featuring arches, columns, and an ornate interior. The scene includes a central figure kneeling before another figure who appears to be of high status, possibly indicated by his posture, attire, and the presence of ornate key on his side. In the foreground, a pair of cherubic figures and a seated, elderly figure observe the scene. The background contains a gathering of people engaged in different activities, enhancing the depth and complexity of the scene. The detailed cross-hatching and use of contrasting light and shadow highlight the figures' robes and the architectural elements, creating a sense of depth and realism.

artworks.title: Beheading of Saint James
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting several figures in a classical architectural setting. The scene showcases a variety of people, both men and women, some standing and some seated, in a crowded environment. The architecture consists of columns, arches, and staircases with different levels and perspectives. The figures are dressed in attire reminiscent of classical Roman or Greek styles. The background includes structures like towers and bridges, suggesting a city scene. The drawing is rich with human activity and emotion, portrayed through the poses and interactions among the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Peter Delivered from Prison by an Angel
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This image shows an angel guiding a man through a dimly lit prison corridor with guards nearby. The corridor features an arched ceiling with a hanging lamp. The foreground shows guards with their heads down, and in the background, other guards appear to be indifferent or unaware. A barred window on the right reveals figures inside a cell. The artwork uses lines and shading to show depth and texture.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Disputes the Sorcerer
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene set in a historically themed setting. The drawing depicts a crowded street lined with classical architecture, including a building with columns and statues, and a fountain in the background. The scene is filled with a dense group of figures in various attires, engaging in discussion or interaction. The architecture in the background suggests a Renaissance setting with detailed brickwork and sculpted elements. In the forefront, there are figures dressed in long robes and cloaks, some gesturing to one another. The composition is detailed, typical of engravings or etchings focusing on historical or biblical themes, capturing daily life or a specific event set against an architecturally rich environment.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Heals the Lame Man at Lystra
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural and figure composition. The scene features a group of figures engaged in various activities, set against a backdrop of classical architecture with textured stone walls and columns. The figures are positioned in a manner that suggests interaction and communication. The background comprises a series of buildings, with arched windows and domes, suggesting a historical or ancient urban setting. The use of lines and shading creates depth and texture, offering a rich and dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Speaks to the Women of Philippi by a River
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered in a setting reminiscent of a historical or biblical scene. The scene includes figures in robes engaged in discussion or listening intently to a central figure speaking near a body of water. In the background are architectural elements like arches, columns, and fortress-like buildings, suggesting an ancient or classical city setting. The drawing is detailed, focusing on the expressions and gestures of the figures and surrounding vegetation, including a tree and palm. Shadows and cross-hatching techniques add depth and texture to the clothing and landscape. Etched inscriptions in Latin are present below the scene, contributing to the historical or narrative feel of the image.

artworks.title: The Jailer about to Kill Himself, Converted by Saint Paul
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures interacting within an architectural setting. The central focus is on a man in the foreground with a sword and torch, moving towards a doorway. Inside the doorway are two figures. The setting includes an archway, stairs, and door structures with detailed line work, highlighting the central characters with the use of lighting.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Driving Out Evil Spirits
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a detailed engraving of a classical setting with various figures in motion and distress. The background features architecture, columns, and buildings. The foreground shows dynamic figures engaged in different activities or states of distress. Some figures appear to be moving quickly, while others are seen in conversation. There is a depiction of smoke or fire on the left, along with figures in action, adding urgency to the scene. The intricate details in clothing, gestures, and facial expressions convey a sense of emotion and turmoil. The architecture with arches and columns adds depth and historical context to the image.

artworks.title: The Fall of Euthychus
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical or biblical scene involving a large group of people in robes, some kneeling, others standing or sitting, focusing their attention on a figure lying on the ground. The setting features marble columns and classical features, and the figures display a range of emotions through their expressions and gestures. Decorative elements like hanging lamps add to the richness of the setting, suggesting a moment of communal participation or witnessing of an event. The drawing has a strong sense of narrative, possibly depicting a scene from religious iconography or classical mythology.

artworks.title: The Arrest of Saint Paul
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic conflict scene within an architectural setting. The image shows a densely packed group of figures engaged in struggle, with energetic movement as they hold spears. The figures are dressed in classical attire, surrounded by architectural elements like columns and an elevated platform. The intricate detail in clothing, muscles, and expressions of the figures is showcased, typical of engraving. The background includes a cityscape with buildings and a large structure with columns. The composition conveys turmoil with a strong narrative element, likely illustrating a specific story or historical event.

artworks.title: Saint Paul before the High Priest
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. It features a group of robed individuals seated in a semicircle, engaged in a discussion or debate. Among them sits an individual gesturing passionately. Figures in armor stand guard to the left, with a soldier leaning against a pillar. The background includes architectural structures suggesting an ancient setting. Latin text is present at the bottom of the drawing.

artworks.title: Saint Paul before Festus and Agrippa
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a court setting. In the foreground, a group of people is gathered, including a regal figure sitting on a throne, with a queen or another lady beside him, surrounded by courtiers and advisors, dressed in historical attire. The scene depicts a judicial or royal session with an audience extending into the background, under the arches of an architectural setting. This is a detailed etching capturing intricate designs of the characters' costumes, textures of fabrics, and ornate architectural elements like columns and draperies overhead. A dog lies on the ground in the center among the gathering. The image is rich in historical references and portrays grandeur and significance.

artworks.title: Saint Paul Shipwrecked on the Island of Melita
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a fire on a coastal landscape. The central scene is dominated by a fire, with individuals gathered around it, some tending to the fire, while others are engaged in various activities such as carrying and presenting goods. The sea forms a backdrop to the right with a large ship. The left side of the image shows an architectural structure where more figures can be seen interacting. The landscape includes barren trees. The detailed linework and shading offer a sense of depth and texture characteristic of the illustrative engraving style.
